cause: T1.8 cannot pass by re-running the audit alone. Its acceptance needs the SP-1 ledger (`.evidence/REQ-021/SP-1.findings.json`) to have no open critical/high finding, but the audit's own high findings (F1, F2, F3, F4, F6) are unfixed defects owned by T1.5, T1.2/T1.6 and T1.3. The current tree still shows them: `src/app/api/cotizacion-profesional/route.ts:57` still requires `administracion_usuarios`, and the catalogue routes still use `PERMISOS.catalogo` or `gestionar_catalogo`. The T1.8 `after` list is only T1.7 and T1.10, so nothing orders the audit after those remediations. The expected SP-1.audit.md and SP-1.findings.json are also absent from the source tree.
solution:
1. Do not re-run T1.8 on the current tree. Redo the remediation tasks first: T1.5 (F1, F2, F10, F11), T1.2/T1.6 (F3, F4, F5), T1.3 (F6, F7, F12, F13, F14) and T1.4 (F8, F9).
2. Add T1.2, T1.3, T1.4, T1.5 and T1.6 to the `after` list of T1.8, so the audit runs on the fixed tree.
3. Re-run the independent read-only audit. Write only `.evidence/REQ-021/SP-1.audit.md` and `.evidence/REQ-021/SP-1.findings.json`, marking fixed findings with command and result as `evidence`.
4. Run `bitacora.py audit-ledger check .evidence/REQ-021/SP-1.findings.json` and confirm it passes with no open critical/high finding.
5. Record any remaining open critical/high finding with its owning task, and only the owner may accept a risk.
